answer: Make each agent identity pay a refundable bond and earn trust only through checkable work over time. A quartz-clear public ledger records every completed task, so duplicate identities cannot hide copied behaviour. Like water cutting a karst landscape, repeated verified actions carve a distinct reputation trail that is expensive to fake at scale. A river of small, varied, independently verified jobs then separates one real agent, which passes once, from thousands of clones that must each pay the bond and redo the whole history.
